info.name: Palo Alto Networks SaaS Security Posture Management API
info.description:
SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM) API for assessing and improving the security posture of connected SaaS applications. Enables onboarding of SaaS applications, retrieval of posture check results, management of remediation status, browsing the SaaS application catalog, and configuration of Jira integrations for ticketing workflows. Part of the Palo Alto Networks SASE platform.

Contact Support:
 Name: Palo Alto Networks Developer Support

item.name: Palo Alto Networks Remove Onboarded Application

variable.description: (Required) Unique identifier of the onboarded application.

request.description: Removes a previously onboarded SaaS application from SSPM. This stops posture scanning for the application and removes all associated check results. This action cannot be undone.

item.name: Palo Alto Networks Onboard New Application

request.description: Onboards a new SaaS application to SSPM for posture assessment. Requires specifying the application type and providing the OAuth consent or API credentials needed to connect to the application. After onboarding, SSPM performs an initial posture scan.
